nodes.summary: Let $S$ be a subset of the plane $\mathbb{R}^2$ such that every subset $T$ of $\mathbb{R}^2$ homeomorphic to $S$ (as a subspace) is Lebesgue measurable, that is, Carathéodory measurable with respect to Lebesgue outer measure on $\mathbb{R}^2$. Then $S$ is absolutely measurable: for every measure $\mu$ on the Borel $\sigma$-algebra of $\mathbb{R}^2$, the set $S$ is Carathéodory measurable with respect to the outer…
